description: Read or change which columns a LIST VIEW shows for THIS user — the same write as ticking a column in the UI's Column Preference menu. Supported lists: epic, feature, userstory, testcase (Test Case list), suite (Suite test-case list), scenario (Test plan test-case list) and executionplan (Execution Plan test-case list, including "Execution Type"). action "get" returns the visible column keys of each list; action "set" enables or disables `column` (a label like "Execution Type", or its key like "executionType") on every list in `lists`, then reads the preferences back to confirm. The change applies to the UI after a refresh.

action.description: get = read visible columns; set = enable/disable a column.

column.description: action "set": column LABEL ("Created On") or key ("createdAt").

enabled.description: action "set": true to show the column (default), false to hide it.

lists.description: Which list views to touch. testcase = Test Cases; suite = Suite test cases; scenario = Test plan test cases; executionplan = Execution Plan test cases.

name: column_preference
title: Read or change list-view COLUMN preferences (SimplifyQA)
